Standing by for changeover to afternoon shift.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:40 – 20:00)
items: Equipment received: 4x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 1x Ops Phone.
Debrief with morning shift complete. No issues to report. Standing by at HQ charging Ops phone.
Ops phone charged; no response calls. Departed HQ and commenced welfare patrol on Queen Street heading to Lorne Street.
Full welfare check on Lorne Street — clear. Welfare checks on upper Queen Street local stores — clear. Heading down Queen Street.
Welfare checks on High Street, Freyberg, Chancery Square, and Vulcan Lane — clear. Heading over to Fort/Gore Street.
Gore/Fort Street welfare sweep complete. No issues. Making our way to Commercial Bay.

Response call from Typo regarding an attempted theft; the POI was verbally aggressive to staff and last seen walking down Queen Street onto Queens Arcade. Store requesting the POI be trespassed. Guards keeping watch while continuing on patrol.
Response call from Red Radisson requesting assistance to remove a guest well past their checkout time. Heading there.
Response call from QF Tavern requesting assistance to remove an aggressive vagrant from the venue.

Arrived at QF Tavern; vagrant had already departed. Spoke to staff for a brief summary (the vagrant had been aggressive, believing staff took his money). Welfare check completed. Resuming patrol towards Red Radisson.

Arrived at Red Radisson; informed staff that removing the POI was out of guards’ hands and to contact Police. Stood by at the entrances to ensure the guest did not leave without paying. Police contacted.
POI has paid for their stay; no further assistance required. Resuming patrol towards Victoria Street.

Response call from Mecca (also posted in the community WhatsApp group) regarding an aggressive vagrant harassing members of the public and showing signs of being under the influence (also reported at 191 Queen Street behaving erratically with drug-use indicators). Heading over.
Approached the vagrant and calmly asked him to stop harassing the public; he was aggressive towards guards. Standing close by to keep watch.
Vagrant moved along but was aggressive towards other vagrants (a potential altercation was averted by guards intervening). Following from a distance in case of further issues.
Followed the vagrant to Commercial Bay; last seen walking into Britomart train station. Standing by the train station.
Standing down from the train station; no sign of the vagrant. Heading back to HQ for 30 minutes.
Standing by for response calls while on break.
Afternoon shift complete. Handing over to night shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (20:40 – 06:30)
items: Equipment handover: 2x Keytags, 1x Ops Phone, 1x Charger, 2x Body Cameras, 2x Vests, 2x Radios, keys for doors.
Welfare check at McDonald’s Queen Street. All clear.
Swiping standby guard up to Level 1.
Standing by in office to charge Ops phone due to low percentage.
Welfare check at Bar101. All clear.
Standing by outside office to let guard inside.
Full sweep of Aotea Square. All clear.
Full sweep of Mayoral Drive and Albert Street. No further issues.
Walking down Wyndham Street to patrol middle Queen Street going up.
Standing by at Bar101 showing presence until floor checks.
Bar101 and Elliott Stables. All clear. Heading back to headquarters to start floor checks.
Leaving Bar101 welfare check. All clear.
Approached by a member of the public notifying that a wanted criminal was walking around Queen Street. Patrolling and showing presence.
Received a call from leader to head to HQ to let him in.
Assistance for HQ. All clear. Continuing patrol.
Full sweep of Queen Street. All clear.
Attempted to remove alcohol at Britomart McDonald’s from a male individual; he came out very aggressive, refused to hand it over, and said inappropriate words towards guards.
Britomart Square and McDonald’s. All clear.
Welfare check at Reign & Pour. All clear.
Walking up from lower Albert Street to Aces.
Full sweep of lower Albert, Aces, upper Albert, Victoria Street, and 77 Convenience Store. No issues.
Arrived at Bar101. Standing by showing presence and keeping the public safe from harm.
Received a call from management (Hasi) requesting to come to Red Radisson on Lorne Street. Two guards stayed at Bar101 while the other two responded.
Arrived at destination; asked to stand by until the guard is brought back.
Guard has arrived at location. No issues. Heading back to Bar101 until closing.
Check-in at 77 Convenience Store. No issues.
Full sweep of Victoria Street. All clear.
Check-in at corner of Lorne Street / Wakefield Street. No issues.
Check-in at Aotea Square. All clear.
Check-in at Queen Street McDonald’s. Heading back to HQ for 30-minute break.
On standby at HQ charging phone.
Patrolling upper Queen for the last 25 minutes.
